name: Frigidaire Gallery® 30" Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel Freestanding Gas Range
shortDescription: Total Convection gives you maximum versatility in the kitchen, powering cooking modes like Air Fry, No Preheat, Slow Cook, Convection Bake, Steam Bake, Convection Roast, Steam Roast, Air Sous Vide and more!

features.text: Slow Cook, Steam Bake plus more, powered by Total Convection
Skip preheating and start baking immediately with No Preheat
Deliver all of the flavor and none of the guilt with Air Fry

The Frigidaire Gallery 30" Rear Control Gas Range features our most powerful and advanced convection system, Total Convection, enabling so many cooking modes like No Preheat, Air Fry, Slow Cook, Steam Bake, Steam Roast, Air Sous Vide, Convection Roast, Convection Bake and more! The flexible five burner cooktop includes a powerful 18,000 BTU Quick Boil Burner and a center oval burner with an integrated cast iron griddle. Also includes our fingerprint resistant, Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel finish.
Start baking immediately with No Preheat
Eliminates time wasted waiting on your oven to heat up - simply place your food in the cold oven and get to meal time, in no time.
Deliver all of the flavor and none of the guilt with Air Fry
Air Fry allows you to make healthier and delicious meals for the entire family, right in your oven.
Flexible Five Element Cooktop
This cooktop has five burners designed to handle all of your cooking needs, including a powerful 18,000 BTU Quick Boil Burner and a center oval burner with an integrated cast iron griddle.
Experience a hassle-free way to cook with Slow Cook
With Slow Cook, your food cooks slowly and at a lower temperature (as low as 100° F), allowing you to lock in moisture and flavor without over or undercooking your food
Achieve bakery results at home with Steam Bake
With Steam Bake, steam evenly circulates throughout the oven cavity, resulting in breads and muffins that rise higher and are light and fluffy.
Enjoy crispy, perfectly roasted meals with Steam Roast
Steam Roast uses moisture to make perfectly crispy and tender meats and vegetables that are roasted to perfection.
Get precise temperature control with Air Sous Vide
Get the benefits of sous vide cooking, right in your oven. Air Sous Vide uses precisely-controlled temperature and airflow to lock in flavor and moisture for yummy, perfectly cooked meals.
Take the guesswork out of cooking with the Temperature Probe
The Temperature Probe monitors and alerts when the desired finished cooking temperature has been reached.
Offers two convenient cleaning options
Enjoy more cleaning flexibility. Select Steam Clean for a quick, 30 minute clean or choose Self Clean, which is available in 2, 3 and 4 hour cycles.
Extra Wide Store-More™ Storage Drawer
Our redesigned Store-More™ Storage drawer is now even wider - allowing you to store any unused oven racks or baking trays.
Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel
Resists fingerprints and cleans easily
